questions.title: Will Senegal's National Assembly be dissolved before January 1, 2027?
questions.background:
According to Senegal's [constitution](https://www.presidence.sn/en/institutions/lassemblee-nationale), "The President of the Republic may, after consultation with the President of the National Assembly and the President of the Constitutional Council, pronounce the dissolution of the National Assembly."

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "da8560be152b8b64", "sheet_id": "129"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), Senegal's current [National Assembly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Assembly_(Senegal)) is formally dissolved before January 1, 2027.
